messages:
Finn Harper: Hey everyone — Finn here, started today on DevEx. I grow microgreens and am inexplicably proud of my bento Tetris skills. Remote Tues/Thurs, in SF office the rest. Quick q: favorite nearby quick lunch spots? Also: who runs the office plant swap? :seedling:
Maya Sato: welcome @Finn! There
re two go-tos: a tiny pho shop two blocks south (fast) and the rooftop picnic tables (slow, but scenic). Plant swap is a thing — Keiko usually coordinates. :smile:
Keiko Tanaka: thate me! :wave: Microgreens sound awesome — bring a tray and wean trade cuttings. Heads up: fridge rule is "no fish after 3pm" (learned the hard way). :sweat_smile:
Ari Park: welcome!! Also FYI the office espresso machine prefers medium grind. If youver want a tour of the Narnia cables under the desks, I volunteer as tribute. :grimacing:
Sam (People Ops): Hi Finn — added you to the Monday lunch rota and the plant-swap calendar. If youver need urgent badge help or parking, DM me. :rocket:
Finn Harper: thanks all! @Keiko I'll bring a small tray next week. Anyone into lunchtime walks? I fold up a bike — can show a 10-min river route that's really peaceful.
welcome-bot: Finn Harper joined #new-hires — welcome message sent.
Keiko Tanaka: river walk + swap on Friday? Count me in. Also what are people's desk snacks? I have emergency wasabi peas.
Ari Park: granola bars and a very sad jar of instant coffee grounds. :coffee:
Maya Sato: we should do a "bring your non-work skill" lunch — Finn can give a 5-min microgreen demo! :tada:
Finn Harper: sold. Microgreen demo and tiny tasting next Wednesday at 12:30. Ian bring labels and a one-sheet with care tips. Looking forward to meeting you all!
